existing_features.title: Add an Android build wrapper for the existing React frontend so the project can be built and distributed as a signed Android .apk.

Ensure Internet Identity authentication works from the Android app context by handling login flow in a way compatible with Android WebView/app wrapper (e.g., opening the identity provider in an external browser/custom tab and returning to the app), without changing the immutable Internet Identity hook files.
Add concise build documentation to the repo describing prerequisites and step-by-step instructions to produce debug and release APK artifacts for the app.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build and deliver an Android APK package for the project

projectName: Package the existing web app as an Android APK
